profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Apex Fintech Solutions
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with over 13 years in the industry and a Master's degree in Computer Science with a specialization in Machine Learning from Georgia Institute of Technology. Skilled in full stack web development and committed to delivering innovative solutions and high-quality software.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Serving as the UI team lead in a team of seven developers. Responsible for planning software architecture, eliminating blockers for teammates, contributing ideas during the design process, and developing using React.
Projects: Astra - A web application that allows registered investment advisors to manage their clients' portfolios.
Technologies: React.js, TypeScript, AG Grid, Storybook, PostgreSQL, Google Cloud
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · AG Grid · TypeScript · Storybooks · PostgreSQL

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Duties: Perform data analysis to identify opportunities to increase revenue. Then design and develop systems that help us exploit those opportunities.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsibilities: Designed and implemented software solutions, primarily focused on user stories but also including internal tools, across multiple projects to support company objectives.

Technologies Used: TypeScript, Node.js, GraphQL, Ruby on Rails, React Native, PostgreSQL

Sample Projects:

direct.beer: A portal enabling retailers to purchase beer and manage inventory efficiently. Additionally, breweries can advertise their products and track sales performance.

TavourApp: A mobile app for Android and iOS that allows consumers to browse and purchase beer directly, catering to end-users with an intuitive and seamless shopping experience.

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.locationName: Buenos Aires, Argentina (remotely from Dominican Republic)
positions.description:
Responsibilities: Collaborated with a team to design and develop the web components of the company’s primary product, CIOM.

Technologies Used: React.js, Node.js, MongoDB, Git, GitLab, Moleculer, Jest

Sample Projects:

CIOM: Developed the front-end for the landing page: https://www.ciom.tech/. Built the back-end and front-end for a new product pricing module. Contributed to various other modules within the project, which aims to empower everyday ndividuals to earn money by serving as mystery shoppers and reporting product prices across different stores.

positions.title: NodeJS Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
Responsibilities: Collaborated with our clients, primarily as a web developer, while also assisting in creating product roadmaps.

Technologies Used: Node.js, React.js, Firebase/Firestore

Sample Projects:

Meteor Fantasy Sport: Developed the back-end and an administrative website to manage the content of a fantasy sports game. Implemented back-end logic to calculate player points based on real-world sports results and determine winners to facilitate payment processing.
Website: https://www.meteorfantasy.com/

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Orange County, California Area (remotely from Dominican Republic)
positions.description:
Responsibilities:  
- Designed and developed web applications following modern best practices.
- Met with clients to understand their needs and translated requirements into well-designed web systems using the latest technologies.  
  
Technologies Used: React.js, Node.js, GraphQL, Microservices architecture, HemeraJS (NATS), Elasticsearch, HTML, Sass (CSS), RabbitMQ (AMQP), Docker  

Sample Projects: Semplice - Developed a full-stack application as part of a team for a California-based startup.Conducted research to understand the domain, helping the client define business rules, scope, and product requirements.

positions.title: Ing. Sistemas Nivel 3 (Systems Engineer Level 3)
positions.description:
Duties: Developed systems (e.g., web-based systems, web services, automation of processes, reports) mainly in Java but also in .Net, Grails/Groovy, Shell Script and many more.

Technologies: OracleDB 11g, JSP and servlets, Java EE5.

Sample Projects: Disponibilidad Claro - Coded and designed software architecture for cellphone inventory checking for clients. 5,000 visits a day. 
Technologies: OracleDB 11g, JSP and servlets, Java EE5.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Duties: Develop web system using latest technologies. 

Technologies: Drupal (PHP), HTML, CSS, JavaScript (jQuery ), MySQL.

Sample Projects:  5050MKT - Developed full web page for publicity and web development company. Full stack with Drupal and jQuery .
Technologies: Drupal (PHP), HTML, CSS, JavaScript (jQuery ), MySQL.
URLs: http://www.5050mkt.com/, https://github.com/arielalvarez88/5050mkt. 
Technologies: Drupal (PHP), HTML, CSS, JavaScript (jQuery ), MySQL.
